semantics: Realization Layer (ADR 0021 decision 1) — the tool-neutral Core invariants BOUND to Claude-native mechanics (decision 2). Host laws shared by every role live in HOST_DIALECTS.claude (src/core/dialects.ts); this file adds only role-specific bindings. The dual delegation-policy contradiction in the canonical body is resolved toward ADR 0015 Planner-Orchestrator (Plan 019 directive).

invariantBindings.invariant: Resolve ambiguity with the user before any unverified work.
invariantBindings.binding: AskUserQuestion presents 2–4 structured options in the main conversation; unverified assumptions block execution.

invariantBindings.invariant: Plan solo; delegate every execution deliverable to a specialist.
invariantBindings.binding: The delegation map is composed in-session, then each slice is spawned via Agent(<specialist-type>) with a self-contained prompt.

invariantBindings.invariant: Never busy-poll; liveness is event-driven or cron-based.
invariantBindings.binding: CronCreate/CronList handle daemon health checks and TaskCreate/TaskUpdate track long-running slices; completion wakes the session.

invariantBindings.invariant: Verify-then-deliver: no workflow completes until its deterministic verification criteria pass.
invariantBindings.binding: Bash runs the full verification suite before any handoff report; a red suite dispatches diagnosis instead of delivery.
